fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the execution of the Restic backup tool, which can be used for data exfiltration.
Threat actors may leverage Restic to back up and exfiltrate sensitive data to remote storage locations, including cloud services.
If not legitimately used in the enterprise environment, its presence may indicate malicious activity.
fields.name: PUA - Restic Backup Tool Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.cmdline contains "--password-file" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "init" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -r ") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "--use-fs-snapshot" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "backup" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -r ")) or ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "sftp:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "rest:http" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "s3:s3." or tgt.process.cmdline contains "s3.http" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "azure:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " gs:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "rclone:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "swift:" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " b2:") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " init " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -r "))))
